concerns.text: The Data Model defines a `NetworkComponent` entity (Section 2.4) but the `contracts/` directory only contains schemas for `subject`, `connectivity`, and `statistical_result`. There is no JSON‑Schema contract for `NetworkComponent`, yet the plan (Phase 2) expects NBS output to conform to a schema (`data/results/nbs_components.json`). This violates the requirement that every data‑model entity be backed by a contract.
